purpose: Teach: 憶測/押しつける/歩む/破る/取り戻し/引っ張り/とらわれ/奪う

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、世論の、本気で、絶対、憶測、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Your paper on public opinion and speculation was remarkably thorough. I was genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured praise. Open with genuine interest. Steady pacing, unhurried. The tone of a teacher who means what she says and doesn't overstate.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。政府が、本気で、絶対、押しつける、絶対、政策、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to examine how government policies are imposed and their deeper implications as carefully as I could.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Speak clearly without rushing—show you've thought about this. Slight warmth underneath the formality. Not defensive, just sincere.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史人物が、本気で、絶対、歩む、絶対、道、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you traced the paths historical figures took—that was particularly insightful. You brought real depth to it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Lean slightly into the praise—this is genuine observation, not performance. Steady eye contact in the voice. A teacher recognizing real work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。約束を、本気で、絶対、破る、絶対、政治家、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to examine how politicians break the promises they make, and that thread felt important to follow through the research.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Speak with intention—this matters to you. Not rushed, but direct. Acknowledge the compliment without dwelling. Move forward with purpose.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化財を、本気で、絶対、取り戻し、絶対、た、絶対、運動、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the section on cultural heritage recovery movements—the work activists did there—you handled that with real care and nuance.
lines.style: Genuine warmth now. Slower, more present. You're acknowledging something that clearly resonated with Sakura. Unrushed, attentive. The voice of someone actually engaged with the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。民衆を、本気で、絶対、引っ張り、絶対、上げた、絶対、運動家、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show how those activists brought people together and created real momentum. That part of the research mattered.
lines.style: Quieter now, more vulnerable. Speak with careful deliberation—you're sharing something that moved you. Not performative, but present. Slight warmth at the edges.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 過去に、本気で、絶対、とらわれ、絶対、ない、絶対、思想、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your thinking wasn't trapped by history—you looked forward, at what these ideas mean now. That's maturity in scholarship.
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle. Slower delivery. This is meaningful feedback, delivered without fanfare. The steadiness of someone who recognizes growth when she sees it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。植民地が、本気で、絶対、奪う、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to understand how colonialism stripped cultures away and what that still means. That felt like the only honest way to write about it.
lines.style: Serious, grounded. Direct without being harsh. Speak from conviction—you're not uncertain here. The slight fatigue of someone who's thought hard about difficult things. Quiet integrity.
